prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Houston, Texas. Injury: back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1274; do not mention it.)
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Houston, Texas, and had slowed down to wait for a gap in oncoming traffic. Traffic was moderate and the light had just turned green for my direction. While I was partway through the turn, another vehicle came through the intersection and struck the driver's side of my car. The impact pushed my vehicle sideways and I felt a sudden jolt through my body. I stayed in my seat until the vehicles came to a stop, then turned off the engine and checked on myself. My lower back was sore and stiff almost immediately, and by the next morning the pain had settled into a strain across my lower back that made it difficult to sit or bend. I have since sought medical care for the injury. I am providing this account so the details of the collision are recorded accurately.
